profile.headline: Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary:
Managed small to medium IBM mainframe based data centers, including attached Unix and Windows environments.  Primary designer and developer for several software products in the commercial software industry.  Experienced with pre-sales and support efforts to deploy software.

Specialties: zSeries, z/OS programming and systems administration.  Programming in Assembler and C.  RACF, Communications (Internet and SNA), storage management, CICS, USS.  IBM Tivoli Identity Manager deployment for managing z/OS environments.  Project management of work involving about 10 people.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the zSecure product to manage IBM security on the IBM z/OS platform.
positions.insights: Skills: SMP/E · Job Control Language (JCL) · Assembly Language · RACF

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description: Skills: SMP/E · Job Control Language (JCL) · Assembly Language · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Contract consultant.
positions.description: Working with Honda's Enterprise Architecture group to plan and implement the use of IBM Tivoli Identity Manager to manage RACF user ID's on their IBM z/OS systems.
positions.insights: Skills: SMP/E · Job Control Language (JCL) · Identity Management

positions.title: Advisory Software engineer
positions.description: Principal in re-write of the MVS/RACF, CA-ACF2 and CA-TopSecret adapters in support of Tivoli Identity Manager (ITIM).  In addition, wrote the documentation, trained support, assist in proof-of-concept implementations, and assist customers as level 3 support.  Performed lead role in the effort to port ITIM (Websphere application) to z/OS.
positions.insights: Skills: SMP/E · Job Control Language (JCL) · C (Programming Language) · TCP/IP · RACF · Corporate Security

positions.title: President / Consultant
positions.description: Provided my services for managing OS/390 and z/OS installations. Provided programming services to replace old bar-code printers with newer technology printers and communications infrastructure.  Wrote prototype software for SSL communications.  Wrote low-level assembler interfaces for managing console operations.

positions.title: Senior software engineer / Team Lead
positions.description: Successfully organized the team to design and develop a new live security database retrieval mechanism. Very few bugs in GA release of the new function. Team successfully performed all Y2K testing for, and reprogramming of, the VRA product. Y2K ready release was available in January 1998. Designed and implemented Vanguard's distributed password administration facility, and CICS password administration facility. Experience with RACF and digital certificates, use of IBM Web Server, LDAP, Host-on-Demand, and UNIX system services on OS/390.  Provide advice and guidance to the technical staff, other team leaders, marketing and sales.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented client/server product using remote procedure calls (RPC). Improved reliability of UX3270 product while implementing serviceability aids to assist customers in the field.  Managed all aspects of IBM mainframe. Responsibilities included maintaining three MVS platforms, the SNA network, and TCP/IP connectivity, for use by software development, customer support, and training departments.

patents.title: Managing and monitoring continuous improvement in detection of compliance violations
patents.description: The disclosure relates generally to an improved data processing system, and more specifically to managing and monitoring continuous improvement in detection of compliance violations. In particular, the disclosure provides a method and system for using compliance violation risk data about an entity to enable an identity management system to dynamically adjust the frequency in which the identity management system performs a compliance check of an identity account associated with the entity.
